running.title: A background task is running
running.detail: Its status will update automatically when it finishes.

failed.title: The latest run did not finish
failed.detail: Check Needs attention for details, or rerun it from Task control.

queued.title: A task is queued
queued.detail: The background worker will start it when available.

completed.title: The latest run is complete
completed.detail: Results have been synced to the relevant papers, reports, or research outputs.

idle.title: No tasks are running
idle.detail: Choose the next action on the right.

daily.title: The daily run is progressing
daily.detail: The current stage, processing progress, and cache status appear below.

recoverable.title: The daily run can resume where it stopped
recoverable.detail: Completed stages are preserved. You can resume or explicitly start over.

report.title: Today's research intelligence report is ready
report.detail: The daily run is complete. Open the report to review screening results and project-level decisions.

rateLimited.title: Source sync is temporarily limited
rateLimited.detail: Once the source recovers, rerun the daily workflow below.

running.title: Research data is updating
running.detail: Relevant papers, reports, and outputs sync automatically when the background task finishes.

failed.title: The previous run needs review
failed.detail: Task details and next actions appear below and in the status center.

queued.title: The next task is waiting
queued.detail: It starts automatically when the background worker is available.

completed.title: This research run is synced
completed.detail: Review the results or continue with the next action on the right.

idle.title: The workspace is ready
idle.detail: Choose your next action or wait for a scheduled task.
